senses.gloss: additional, a person having an additional limb.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Bekh. VII, 6</cite> <he>י׳ בידיו וכ׳</he> if one has an additional finger (or toe) on each of his hands and feet.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 40a:12">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>חסר וי׳ ביד</he> having one toe less or one too many on the forefoot.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 40a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>כל יתיר כנטול דמי</he> every addition is considered equal to the entire absence of the respective limb; <cite ref="Chullin 58b:4">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>כל יתר וכ׳</he>.
B. Bath. VII, 2, sq. הן י׳ (יתיר a. יתר interchanging), v. הֵן; a. fr.—Fem. יְתֵרָה, יְתֵירָה; (as noun also) יְתֶרֶת, יְתֶירֶת.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Bekh. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:2">45ᵃ</cite>) <he>היתה</he> (<he>בה</he>) <he>בו יתרת וכ׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="J00740"><he>יתירה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>יתירת</he>) if there has been an additional limb and he had it cut off. Ib. 40ᵃ <he>י׳ על של משה וכ׳</he> (a cubit measure) larger than the Mosaic by &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:6">Ḥull. III, 6</cite> (as a sign of clean birds) <he>כל שיש לו אצבע י׳</he> that which has an additional toe (on top of those in a line).
<cite ref="Ketubot 76a:4">Keth. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>יתירת</he> a woman having an additional limb.

<cite ref="Eruvin 83a:14">Erub. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ על מדברית וכ׳</he> one sixth larger than &c.; a. fr. [V. <cite ref="J00740"><he>יְתֵירָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>יְתֵרִים</he>, <he>יְתֵרִין</he>, <cite ref="J00737"><he>יְתֵי׳</he></cite>; f. <he>יְתֵירוֹת</he>.

Macc. 23ᵃ יְתֵירֵי מדע men of more than ordinary knowledge; י׳ כח of more than common physical strength.—[Gen. R. s. 98 הניחו יתירות left remants of the conquered nations, prob. to be read: יְתֵידוֹת, v. יָתֵד.]—Esp. יְתֶרֶת an additional lobe of the lungs.

senses.gloss: a word written plene, with vowel letters.—Pl. יְתֵירוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13a:21">Erub. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="H01412"><he>חָסֵר</he> II</cite>.
